values.goal: Complete findings-first retained reviews for every closed v0.91.7 sprint whose review is missing or materially incomplete.
values.required_outcome: Ten separate source-grounded sprint review packets, an updated canonical register, and explicit remediation routing without implementation changes.
authority_boundary: Live GitHub issue and PR state is authoritative for remote closure truth
Repository source and retained artifacts are authoritative for implementation and proof claims
Review findings cannot manufacture missing historical validation
